blurb: Guests rent U.S. Coast Guard approved pontoon boats with Yamaha Four Stroke Outboard motors. Boats include life jackets for all sizes, two anchors, bimini tops, and a local waters map. Rentals are flexible between 8:00am and 5:00pm.
extraNote: $1,000 Alcohol Consumption Deposit required; forfeited if vessel damaged, returned late, or disorderly conduct · No grills allowed on boats; violation results in $1,000 charge · Additional $200 charge if stranded on beach and need assistance · Parking limited; 1-2 vehicles max per boat rental; extra vehicles may be charged $50 or unavailable · No personal watercraft (PWC) or jet skis allowed with pontoon rentals; reservation cancelled if referenced · No towing tubes, skis, wakeboards, or similar towables allowed
